articles.title: Tamil Nadu Row: Udhayanidhi Stalin Detained, DMK Protests Erupt Across State
articles.description: Political tensions have escalated in Tamil Nadu after Leader of Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin was detained following controversy over his remarks involving actress Trisha, who is known to be close to Chief Minister Vijay. The action against Udhayanidhi Stalin has triggered protests by DMK supporters across several parts of the state. After police reached Udhayanidhi Stalin’s residence and took him into custody, DMK workers came out on streets in multiple cities, raising slogans and opposing the police action. Visuals showed clashes between protesters and police personnel in some areas as authorities attempted to control the situation. According to reports, the controversy began during a public meeting in Thanjavur related to the Cauvery water issue, where Udhayanidhi Stalin made comments that drew criticism from political opponents and supporters of Vijay’s party. Demands for strict action intensified after the remarks, leading to police intervention. At present, Tamil Nadu Police is reportedly proceeding with further legal action while Udhayanidhi Stalin remains in custody. Supporters from both DMK and TVK have gathered, increasing concerns over a possible escalation of tensions. The incident has created a fresh political confrontation in Tamil Nadu, with opposition parties and supporters demanding accountability while DMK workers continue to protest against the detention of their leader. Police deployment has been increased in sensitive areas to maintain law and order.
